newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sees May rise in gasoline price - paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sees May rise in gasoline price - paper.

text.p: In its talks with the International Monetary Fund, Venezuela proposed raising gasoline prices by 50 percent in two stages, the first in May and the second in June, according to a local newspaper report.

The Economia Hoy newspaper said the plan was prepared by state-owned Petroleos de Venezuela and it could be put into effect without liberalization of the domestic retail market, which is currently being discussed by Congress.
"Oil company sources say the increase would be passed with the new minimum salary on May 1," the report said.

According to the plan, prices would reach 85 percent of the free on board (fob) shipping price by the middle of the year, equivalent to 90 bolivars (19 cents) per litre for high octane fuel and 75 bolivars (16 cents) for low octane.
